_comment: Colloquial behaviour knobs. The lessons themselves are the unit files in src/data/colloquial/; this file is only the rules they are held to and how the tab runs.
_comment-types: Every exercise type: which optional lists it may carry (lists), how it is answered (input: text, choice or shadow) and whether the mic is offered (speak). The validator, loader and exercise UI all read this; unit.schema.json lists the same names and a test keeps the two equal.
_comment-minimums: The fewest items a lesson may have in each list. Below this a lesson is reported, not hidden.
_comment-copy: Every word the tab shows that is not lesson content.
